title: 第519章 断其一指第519章 断其一指
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 轰！
江渊的脑海中仿佛有一道惊雷炸响。
江家？！
“不对，这不是现在。”
江渊深吸一口气，强行压下心头的震动。
他闭上双眼，识海中的【太上三生天仙鉴】悄然运转，镜面之上混沌翻涌，却无法与这片天地产生任何关于时间线的共鸣。
江渊猛地睁开双眼，眼底闪过一抹骇人的精芒，脑海中浮现出一个令人毛骨悚然的推断。
这里似乎不是过去，不是现在，也不是任何一种可能性的未来。
甚至，这里更不是那个统御三十八座大世界、生机勃勃的帝仙大世界。
江渊环顾着那无边无际的死寂，感受着空气中连天道法则都彻底断绝的毁灭气息，语气中透着一股极度的冰冷。
“这是……覆灭之后的世界！”
整个帝仙大世界，从高高在上的古皇大帝，到芸芸众生，所有的生灵……全都死光了！
就在这时。
毫无征兆地，一股让江渊都感到心悸的恐怖意志，自那暗红色的天穹之上，缓缓降临。
整个废墟世界，都在这股意志下颤抖。
江渊猛地抬头。
只见天穹之上，那无数道狰狞的裂痕之中，一只巨大到无法想象的手掌，正缓缓地探出。
那手掌遮天蔽日，五指修长，皮肤呈现出一种灰败的石质色泽，上面布满了玄奥而古老的纹路。
它仅仅是出现，一股凌驾于万道之上的意志，便将江渊死死锁定。
“斩断成仙路的大手！”
江渊的瞳孔骤然收缩，脑海中瞬间浮现出在百花宫梳妆阁内，觅月仙留下的那段残缺记忆。
那只抹杀了第一位人皇，父亲告诉的那只斩断诸天万界成仙希望，让觅月仙不惜将自身一分为三也要躲避的……灭世巨手！
那巨手缓缓下压，目标明确，就是要将江渊这个不该出现在此地的“异物”，彻底碾碎！
“想杀本帝？就凭你这一只不知道哪里来的烂手？！”
面对这等足以让任何一位大帝绝望的灭世一击，江渊的眼中却没有丝毫恐惧，反而爆发出了一股前所未有的狂热战意！
“众灵我！”
江渊仰天长啸，一头黑发在狂风中肆意狂舞。
他体内的大帝境七重天巅峰修为，在这一刻毫无保留地彻底爆发！
以江渊为中心，无数道肉眼无法看见的因果之线，仿佛能跨越了梦境与现实的壁垒，瞬间连接到了天帝行宫内那数十位与他命运相连的绝世女帝身上！
姬天心的天心道骨！
凤扶摇的涅槃神火！
敖雪的真龙圣体！
白清雪与白初初的太古白虎庚金杀伐之力！
叶灵仙的九天玄女之力！
云璃的时空法则！
幽姬的阴阳造化！
数十种位列诸天万界最顶端的至高法则，圣体本源……通过【众灵我】的桥梁，在这一刻尽数加于江渊一身！
他的气息，在三息之内，从大帝境七重天巅峰，一路飙升，直接冲破了八重天、九重天的壁垒，达到了一个前所未有的无限接近于天帝境的恐怖层次！
甚至，在那股融合了众生之力、隐隐透着一股人皇道韵的气息推动下，江渊的战力，在这一刻都放肆触及到了那层不可言说的“仙道壁垒”！
江渊右手虚握，体内浩瀚如海、融合了数十种至高法则的恐怖力量在虚空中凝聚成一柄黑白双色交织的古朴长剑！
content_en:
boom!
There seemed to be a thunderclap in Jiang Yuan's mind.
Jiang family? !
"No, this is not now."
Jiang Yuan took a deep breath and suppressed the shock in his heart.
He closed his eyes, and the [Tai Shang San Sheng Tian Xian Jian] in the sea of ​​​​consciousness was quietly moving. Chaos surged on the mirror surface, but it could not resonate with the timeline of this world.
Jiang Yuan opened his eyes suddenly, a terrifying light flashed in his eyes, and a chilling inference appeared in his mind.
This seems not to be the past, not the present, or any possible future.
Even this is not the vibrant world of the Emperor Immortal that governs the thirty-eight great worlds.
Jiang Yuan looked around at the boundless silence, feeling the aura of destruction in the air that completely cut off even the laws of heaven, and there was an extreme coldness in his tone.
"This is... the world after destruction!"
In the entire world of Emperors and Immortals, from the lofty Ancient Emperor to all living beings, all living beings...are all dead!
Just then.
Without warning, a terrifying will that made Jiang Yuan feel palpitations slowly descended from the dark red sky.
The entire ruined world is trembling under this will.
Jiang Yuan raised his head suddenly.
I saw an unimaginably huge hand slowly protruding from the countless ferocious cracks in the sky.
The palm covered the sky and the sun, the fingers were slender, and the skin showed a grayish stone color, covered with mysterious and ancient lines.
Just by its appearance, Jiang Yuan was locked onto Jiang Yuan with a will that was superior to all the ways.
"The big hand that cuts off the path to immortality!"
Jiang Yuan's pupils suddenly shrank, and the incomplete memory left by Mi Yuexian in the dressing room of Baihua Palace suddenly appeared in his mind.
The one that obliterated the first Human Emperor, the one that my father told me cut off the hope of becoming an immortal in all the worlds, and made Miyue Immortal avoid even splitting herself into three...the world-destroying giant hand!
The giant hand slowly pressed down with a clear goal, which was to completely crush Jiang Yuan, a "foreign object" that shouldn't be here!
"Want to kill this emperor? Just with your bad hands who don't know where they came from?!"
Faced with such a world-destroying blow that could make any emperor despair, Jiang Yuan's eyes showed no trace of fear. Instead, he burst out with an unprecedented fanatical fighting spirit!
"All the spirits me!"
Jiang Yuan looked up to the sky and roared, his black hair dancing wildly in the strong wind.
The peak level of cultivation at the seventh level of the Great Emperor in his body completely exploded without reservation at this moment!
Buzz—!
With Jiang Yuan as the center, countless lines of cause and effect that are invisible to the naked eye seem to cross the barrier between dreams and reality, and instantly connect to the dozens of peerless empresses in the palace of the Emperor of Heaven who are connected to his destiny!
Ji Tianxin’s Tianxin Daogu!
Feng Fuyao’s Nirvana Divine Fire!
Ao Xue’s True Dragon Holy Body!
Bai Qingxue and Bai Chuchu's ancient white tiger Gengjin killing power!
Ye Lingxian’s power of the Nine Heavens Mysterious Girl!
Yunli's laws of time and space!
You Ji’s yin and yang creation!
…
Dozens of supreme laws that rank at the top of all heavens and realms, the origin of the Holy Body... are all added to Jiang Yuan's body at this moment through the bridge of [All Spirits I]!
Within three breaths, his aura soared from the peak of the seventh heaven to the Great Emperor Realm, directly breaking through the barriers of the eighth and ninth heavens, reaching an unprecedented level of terror that was infinitely close to the Heavenly Emperor Realm!
Even, driven by the aura that fused the power of all living beings and faintly revealed the charm of the Human Emperor, Jiang Yuan's combat power boldly touched the indescribable "immortal barrier" at this moment!
"Condensation!"
Jiang Yuan held his right hand empty, and the terrifying power in his body, which was as vast as the sea and integrated with dozens of supreme laws, condensed into a simple black and white long sword in the void!
